Blog Post: The Weekend Loaf
Posted by: Rosa Villanueva
Date: August 9
Title: Opening Our New Reader Board!

Because of the huge number of questions I get every day, I have decided to open a dedicated message board for my readers. This space is meant for anyone trying to bake bread in a small home kitchen.

While my expertise lies primarily in sourdough, I know many of you care about other topics like pastry and gluten-free flours. So I encourage my long-time readers to step forward and guide those who are just beginning. I will stop in to give advice when I can, but I want this to be a place where you learn from one another.

Let’s help each other turn our tiny kitchens into real bakeries!
